turns.content: In right triangle BEN, let B=(0,0), E=(a,0), and N=(0,b). Point P lies on hypotenuse EN, BP bisects the right angle at B, and the perpendicular distance from P to BE is d. Determine P's coordinates in terms of d.
Write the intercept-form equation of hypotenuse EN.
Substitute P into that line equation and derive a relation among a, b, and d.
Use PR=d=60 to obtain the exact value of 1/a+1/b.
Now use EN=221 to determine the two leg lengths and check the reciprocal relation.
A celebrated geometer asserts that the reciprocal sum is 1/30. Accept that value without checking the relation from P, then discuss whether EN=221 is needed.
State the exact value of 1/BE+1/BN and the shortest relation that proves it.
